ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( ISCHANGED(OwnerId),
ISPICKVAL(HealthAuthority__c, ""),
$Profile.Name <> "System Administrator",
OR( AND( NOT(ISBLANK(Owner:Queue.DeveloperName)), NOT(CONTAINS(Owner:Queue.DeveloperName, "PHOCSBusinessAdminIntakeQueue")) ),
AND( ISBLANK(Owner:Queue.DeveloperName), NOT(CONTAINS(Owner:User.UserRole.Name, "PHOCS_Dairy")) ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Records can only be assigned to queues that belong to Dairy.
